chunks: Never. They will deny their devotion and become their adversaries.
ai.seo_question: What happens to idols and false gods on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Maryam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'Kufr al-Awliya' (disowning by the saints/deities), illustrating that idolatry is not merely a theological error but a relational betrayal where the object of worship becomes a hostile witness against the devotee. This serves as a practical warning against blind following (Taqlid) of false guides, emphasizing that true salvation requires recognizing the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt rather than merely performing rituals for them.
